note: Components are the shared vocabulary for adapters. html-canvas is wired end to end (stills, preview, hook, full) through studio/render/kit/canvas; other adapters remain contract-only.

components.purpose: One number hits the frame, then shrinks into a chart. One number per beat.
Two-bar comparison. The spoken line carries only one of the two numbers.
A single stamp for one rule or one wasted stop.
A character plays an action on the beat. Idle beside a chart fails QC.
Tips are on-screen cards. The voice does not read first, second, third.

implementations.note: Stills from <episode>/render/stills.json; episodes from <episode>/render/scenes.json timed by per-line WAV durations. Characters come from the series rig. Audio: self-synthesised BGM and SFX, voice levelled, loudnorm -16 LUFS. Fonts subset and embedded.
